title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions and Node to 20
author: Ava Ramos
description:
Motivation: our repo has accumulated several overlapping GH Actions workflows for linting, unit/integration tests, and release automation. That duplication increases maintenance cost and leads to inconsistent caching and Node versions across packages. This PR consolidates CI workflows into a smaller set of reusable workflows, upgrades actions to their latest stable versions, standardizes Node 20 across builds, and fixes several flaky caching keys.

What changed (high level): consolidated .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} into two workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint + unit/integration test matrix) and .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation using release-please + tag publishing). Introduced a lightweight composite action under .github/actions/ci-helpers to centralize cache key logic and checkout/setup steps. Switched actions/checkout@v4 and setup-node@v4, removed deprecated uses of setup-node v2. Standardized npm ci install, pinned pnpm usage to repo top-level where applicable. Replaced multiple duplicate cache keys with a deterministic key that includes package-lock hash and node-version.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and removed duplicates - [x] Upgraded GH Actions (checkout, setup-node, cache) - [x] Standardized Node to 20 across all jobs - [x] Added composite action for CI helpers to reduce duplication - [x] Fixed flaky caches and improved cache hit metrics on Canary runs - [x] Updated docs: docs/ci.md and README CI section

Notes & caveats: - The release workflow preserves existing release-please configuration, but now runs from the single release workflow so the schedule/dispatch behavior is centralized. - Some non-main repos (tools/monorepo-scripts) still use custom pipelines; this PR does not modify those. - I intentionally kept matrix dimensions minimal to preserve throughput while keeping coverage.

References: Linear ENG-5890, ENG-6050. Related PRs: pr-50321 (previous consolidation attempt), pr-51234 (node deps hygiene).
